title: The γ ≤ 1/2 campaign
convention: Weights are the estimated size of each work package (thousands of new Lean lines; non-Lean steps get an equivalent weight). A finished package counts fully. A running package counts in proportion to the Lean it has written that compiles in the work area (part of it adapted from the existing proof), capped at 75 % until the package passes its checks and is accepted.

integration: about a dozen packages must meet at exact interfaces
